intro: Exact current scope, fees and an explicit decision. Beirut Time is a marketplace, not the seller or workshop.
emptyBody: New offers and assessed quotes appear here after they are actually submitted.
offerUnavailableBody: Check the current sale state or browse another watch. Saved offers are still shown below.
pending: Reservation pending — outcome unknown. Retry the same operation; no payment has been confirmed.
declined_return_held: Controlled unrepaired return held; custody retained
sample: Sample fee and commission policy — exact saved amounts, not approved commercial rates. No charge or work is confirmed here.
unavailable: A required service is unavailable. Nothing is confirmed. Retry safely.
conflict: The scope, expiry or revision changed. Reload and explicitly review the current version.
denied: Your current identity or selected business cannot do this.
signInBody: Use your current account to review private offers and quotes.
termsConsent: I accept only these selected current lines, the exact total and the displayed terms.
noExecution: Acceptance is scoped consent, not payment, physical custody, or completed work.
startAssessment: Open a current qualified assessment to issue a quote. No diagnosis or approval is inferred here.
offerSent: Offer saved; the actual seller must answer.
quoteSaved: Exact quote saved. Buyer acceptance is still required.
requiredFields: Use exact positive amounts with at most two decimal places.
